verdict.rationale: logo-design-skill is an Agent Skill that guides an agent through a logo design workflow, from brief to SVG files and brand guidelines. It has no user-defined automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this product. The 'you want changes' loop back to concept refinement is design iteration, not automation version control or rollback, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
